scope: One fresh worker per case, sequential; no chunking. Selected JAX backend is recorded. Identical coil DOFs, births, fields, horizons, save times and fixed-axis mean-final-radius objective.
collision_comparison: Production native adaptive/fixed split maps versus production fixed Diffrax SDE. Different Brownian generators/noise bases and integrators; not a pathwise accuracy or gradient-equality comparison.
memory_scope: Per-worker fused-objective peak RSS measured before standalone F/R and validation executables are built; includes setup and compilation. Also retain complete-worker peak and compiler buffer estimates.

metadata.parameters: 136 bundled QA coil Fourier/normalized-current DOFs only; fixed reference axis and births
metadata.background: Hydrogen, 1e20 m^-3, 1 keV; production coefficient model
metadata.memory_scope: Fused peak includes input setup, fused compilation, first and warm execution; measured before separate forward/reverse or FD validation executables exist. Warm RSS includes resident JAX/executables/allocator. Compiler buffers are separate.
metadata.timing_scope: Warm blocked calls, compilation excluded. Forward is ordinary production solve; linearization is public VJP of jitted cost; reverse reuses its residuals; fused is value_and_grad. No particle chunks.
